projects.title: Morning Sun Family Sanctuary
projects.rooms_needed: 4 Bedrooms, 3.5 Baths, Home Office, Sunlit Kitchen & Walk-in Pantry
projects.description: We want our living area and breakfast nook flooded with morning sunlight. The children need a safe playroom on the ground floor with views from the kitchen, and my partner needs a quiet, sound-insulated office for video calls. An outdoor deck connected seamlessly to the kitchen is a must!
projects.special_requirements: Wheelchair-friendly guest bedroom on ground floor; provision for future solar rooftop panels; warm wooden textures instead of cold hospital whites.

technical_summary.spatial_layout: Open-concept continuous spatial flow with column-free spans, integrating kitchen-dining-living into a unified great room with visual axis to outdoor courtyard.
technical_summary.fenestration_and_lighting: High-performance solar orientation: East/South-facing clerestory glazing, floor-to-ceiling curtain walls, and UV-filtering double-glazed units for daylight factor optimization.
technical_summary.structural_and_materials: Reinforced concrete post-and-beam with glulam timber accents, engineered white oak flooring, acoustic plasterboard ceiling panels.
sustainability_and_mep: Rooftop Photovoltaic (PV) array conduit pre-install & inverter battery storage provision.
STC 55+ acoustic partition assemblies for sound transmission loss in office suite.
ADA Universal Design compliance: zero-threshold entries and ground floor accessible suite.
kickoff_alignment_checklist: Confirm preferred floor-to-ceiling heights (9ft standard vs 10.5ft voluminous).
Review municipal setback rules for corner lot driveway positioning.
Verify passive shading overhang depth to prevent summer glare.

projects.title: Catalyst Creative Tech Hub & Cafe
projects.rooms_needed: Ground Floor Espresso Bar, 2 Floors Open Co-working & Boardrooms
projects.description: A vibrant multi-use creative commercial building. Street-facing public coffee roastery on ground floor, with modern tech offices above featuring high ceilings, exposed black steel framing, and glass partitions.
projects.special_requirements: Heavy acoustic dampening between cafe and 2nd floor offices; freight elevator or wide service staircase; high-capacity fiber routing conduits.

technical_summary.spatial_layout: Mixed-use vertical zoning: public mercantile at grade level with secured access control to upper-level creative studios.
technical_summary.fenestration_and_lighting: Storefront commercial glazing system with acoustic laminate panes (OITC 38) and industrial aluminum mullions.
technical_summary.structural_and_materials: Exposed structural steel portal frames, corrugated metal composite decking with 4-inch concrete slab top.
sustainability_and_mep: Dedicated outdoor air system (DOAS) with heat recovery ventilation for high-occupancy workspaces.
High-density STC 60 acoustic floor barrier separating ground floor roastery from second floor workspaces.
kickoff_alignment_checklist: Confirm municipal commercial parking stalls ratio requirements.
Verify fire sprinkler riser placement and dual egress emergency stairs.

projects.title: Meadowview Eco-Cabin & Studio
projects.rooms_needed: 1 Bedroom, Loft Sleeping, Compact Kitchenette, Covered Porch
projects.description: Looking to build an off-grid tiny cabin retreat with a sleeping loft, compost toilet plumbing setup, wood burning stove, and a covered porch to watch sunsets.
projects.special_requirements: Off-grid solar battery bank storage space; rainwater harvesting tank integration; lightweight framing easy to build on rocky ground.

technical_summary.spatial_layout: Micro-compact multi-functional envelope with vertical volume utilization via mezzanine loft.
technical_summary.fenestration_and_lighting: Strategic western operable awning windows for sunset views with deep eaves for solar shading.
technical_summary.structural_and_materials: Helical screw pile foundation with light wood-frame SIPs (Structural Insulated Panels) for rapid assembly.
sustainability_and_mep: Zero-grid DC micro-distribution electrical setup.
Rainwater filtration & gravity-fed graywater irrigation.
kickoff_alignment_checklist: Confirm local building codes regarding tiny home minimum square footage regulations.
Determine soil bearing capacity for screw pile anchoring.

projects.title: Discovery Early Learning Academy
projects.rooms_needed: 4 Classrooms, Sensory Play Hall, Staff Lounge, Secure Courtyard
projects.description: A dedicated kindergarten school prioritizing safety, soft daylight, low windowsill heights so kids can see outside, and an internal courtyard shielded from the street.
projects.special_requirements: Rounded interior wall corners; non-toxic linoleum flooring; panic button access control doors.

technical_summary.spatial_layout: Single-story perimeter ring layout oriented around a secure central courtyard playground.
technical_summary.fenestration_and_lighting: Low sill height windows (18" above finished floor) with laminated safety glass.
technical_summary.structural_and_materials: Non-combustible steel framing with impact-resistant wallboard and bio-based linoleum flooring.
sustainability_and_mep: Low-VOC finishes and high-efficiency MERV 13 filtration ventilation.
Full ADA child-accessible fixture heights throughout all washrooms.
kickoff_alignment_checklist: Verify state childcare licensing capacity guidelines.
Confirm playground safety fall zone clearances.

messages.message_text: Hi Alex! Welcome to Build My Vision. I have reviewed your submission and translated your daylight requirements into high-performance clerestory glazing specifications. I just uploaded the draft floor plans!
Thank you Elena! The layout is wonderful. I pinned a quick note on Deliverable #1 about widening the sliding glass door to the patio. Take a look and let me know if that works structurally!
Absolutely! I checked the load-bearing lintel calculations—we can easily expand it to 12ft with a steel header beam. Updating the 3D render now!

✅ I have chosen: "L-Shaped with Landing & Safety Rail"! (Note: We want the landing for child safety and comfortable climbing.)
🎨 Design Options for your review: "Staircase Style Proposals for Hillside Haven". Click on the 'Design Options' tab to view and pick your favorite!
